q: 商店的门还___，你快进去吧。
zh: 商店的门还开着，你快进去吧。
py: shāng diàn de mén hái kāi zhe nǐ kuài jìn qù ba
en: The shop door is still open, so go in quickly.
why: 还 says the door is still in the open state, and 着 reports a state. 开了 only reports that it opened and clashes with 还; 在开 would mean it is in the middle of opening.

q: 他手里一直拿___一张购物卡。
zh: 他手里一直拿着一张购物卡。
py: tā shǒu lǐ yī zhí ná zhe yī zhāng gòu wù kǎ
en: He has been holding a shopping card in his hand the whole time.
why: 一直 describes a held state, so the verb takes 着. 拿了 reports one act of taking, and 拿过 means he has held one before; neither can be stretched by 一直.

q: 她从早上到现在一直戴___那条新项链。
zh: 她从早上到现在一直戴着那条新项链。
py: tā cóng zǎo shang dào xiàn zài yī zhí dài zhe nà tiáo xīn xiàng liàn
en: She has been wearing that new necklace all day, from morning until now.
why: 从早上到现在一直 describes one unbroken state of wearing, which is 戴着. 戴过 is 'has worn it before' and 戴了 reports putting it on; neither fits an unbroken stretch.

q: 篮球场的灯还___呢，他们还在练球。
zh: 篮球场的灯还亮着呢，他们还在练球。
py: lán qiú chǎng de dēng hái liàng zhe ne tā men hái zài liàn qiú
en: The lights at the basketball court are still on; they are still practising.
why: 还 … 呢 describes lights that are on at this moment, so 亮着. 亮了 only says they came on, and 亮过 says they were on at some earlier time.

q: 跑步机一直开___，电费特别高。
zh: 跑步机一直开着，电费特别高。
py: pǎo bù jī yī zhí kāi zhe diàn fèi tè bié gāo
en: The treadmill has been left running all the time, so the electricity bill is very high.
why: A machine that stays switched on is a continuing state: 开着. 一直 rules out 开了, which marks one change of state, and 开过 would mean it was on once in the past.

q: 比赛早就结束了，他还穿___球衣呢。
zh: 比赛早就结束了，他还穿着球衣呢。
py: bǐ sài zǎo jiù jié shù le tā hái chuān zhe qiú yī ne
en: The match ended long ago and he is still wearing his jersey.
why: 'Still wearing' is a state after the putting-on, so 穿着. 在穿 would mean he is in the act of putting it on, which does not fit a match that ended long ago.

q: 虽然商场已经关门了，可是后门还___，我们进去看看吧。
zh: 虽然商场已经关门了，可是后门还开着，我们进去看看吧。
py: suī rán shāng chǎng yǐ jīng guān mén le kě shì hòu mén hái kāi zhe wǒ men jìn qù kàn kan ba
en: Although the mall has already closed, the back door is still open, so let's go in and look.
why: 可是 … 还 points to a door that remains open now: 开着. 开了 would say the door opened, and 开过 would say it has been open at some time before.

q: 妈妈___试鞋，你先别催她。
zh: 妈妈在试鞋，你先别催她。
py: mā ma zài shì xié nǐ xiān bié cuī tā
en: Mom is trying on shoes, so don't rush her.
why: An ordinary action being performed right now takes 在. 试着 would read as 'try to', and 试了 is finished, which does not fit 别催她.

q: 小王穿___一件红球衣，很好认。
zh: 小王穿着一件红球衣，很好认。
py: xiǎo wáng chuān zhe yī jiàn hóng qiú yī hěn hǎo rèn
en: Xiao Wang is wearing a red jersey, so he is easy to spot.
why: 'Is wearing' is the state after putting on, so 穿着. 穿在 cannot take the object 一件红球衣 in this way, and 在穿 would mean he is putting it on.

q: 店员___开门，你再等一分钟。
zh: 店员在开门，你再等一分钟。
py: diàn yuán zài kāi mén nǐ zài děng yī fēn zhōng
en: The clerk is opening up the shop, so wait one more minute.
why: The clerk is still performing the action of opening up, so 在开门. 着 cannot sit on 店员 + 开门 like this; 开着门 would describe a door already standing open, which would make waiting pointless.

q: 窗户___，你把它关上吧。
zh: 窗户开着，你把它关上吧。
py: chuāng hu kāi zhe nǐ bǎ tā guān shàng ba
en: The window is open, so close it.
why: A window that is open is a state: 开着. 在开 would mean the window is moving open at this moment, which no one would ask you to close.

q: 他___外套，你等他一下，马上就好。
zh: 他在穿外套，你等他一下，马上就好。
py: tā zài chuān wài tào nǐ děng tā yī xià mǎ shàng jiù hǎo
en: He is putting on his coat, so wait for him a moment; he'll be ready soon.
why: 'Is putting on' is the action in progress, so 在穿. 穿着 would say the coat is already on him, and then there would be nothing to wait for.

q: 我发现体育馆的门一直___，所以好多人随便进出。
zh: 我发现体育馆的门一直开着，所以好多人随便进出。
py: wǒ fā xiàn tǐ yù guǎn de mén yī zhí kāi zhe suǒ yǐ hǎo duō rén suí biàn jìn chū
en: I found that the gym door had been open all along, so lots of people came and went as they pleased.
why: The door stays in the open state the whole time, so 开着. 一直在开 would mean it keeps opening, and 开了 cannot be stretched by 一直.

q: 小李___一件黑色的运动服，我一眼就认出他了。
zh: 小李穿着一件黑色的运动服，我一眼就认出他了。
py: xiǎo lǐ chuān zhe yī jiàn hēi sè de yùn dòng fú wǒ yī yǎn jiù rèn chū tā le
en: Xiao Li was wearing a black tracksuit, and I recognised him at a glance.
why: Recognising him by what he wore needs the state 穿着. 在穿 would mean he was busy putting it on, which is not how you spot someone at a glance.

q: 他___打电话，不能和我们去买东西。
zh: 他在打电话，不能和我们去买东西。
py: tā zài dǎ diàn huà bù néng hé wǒ men qù mǎi dōng xi
en: He is on the phone and can't go shopping with us.
why: An ordinary action in progress takes 在. A bare 他打着电话 sounds unfinished, as if a second action must follow.

q: 老板娘笑___收下了我的钱。
zh: 老板娘笑着收下了我的钱。
py: lǎo bǎn niáng xiào zhe shōu xià le wǒ de qián
en: The shopkeeper took my money with a smile.
why: The smile is the manner of the main verb 收下, so 着 goes on the first verb 笑. 笑了 would end the smiling before the next action and does not join the two verbs this way.

q: 他站___吃冰淇淋。
zh: 他站着吃冰淇淋。
py: tā zhàn zhe chī bīng qí lín
en: He eats his ice cream standing up.
why: 站 is the posture while eating, so it takes 着 and 吃 stays bare. 站了 or 站在 cannot be followed directly by another verb in this way.

q: 弟弟每天骑___自行车去公园打球。
zh: 弟弟每天骑着自行车去公园打球。
py: dì di měi tiān qí zhe zì xíng chē qù gōng yuán dǎ qiú
en: My younger brother rides his bike to the park to play ball every day.
why: Riding is the way he travels while going to play, so 骑着 marks the manner. 每天 is a habit, so 骑了 (a completed act) and 骑过 (an experience) both fail.

q: 她哭___跑出了商店，钱包也忘在柜台上了。
zh: 她哭着跑出了商店，钱包也忘在柜台上了。
py: tā kū zhe pǎo chū le shāng diàn qián bāo yě wàng zài guì tái shàng le
en: She ran out of the shop crying and even left her wallet on the counter.
why: 哭 describes how she ran out, so it takes 着 and the main verb 跑出 carries the 了. 哭了 or 哭过 placed straight before 跑出 does not link the two actions.

q: 他靠___墙看球赛，一动也不动。
zh: 他靠着墙看球赛，一动也不动。
py: tā kào zhe qiáng kàn qiú sài yī dòng yě bù dòng
en: He leaned against the wall watching the match, without moving at all.
why: 靠 gives the posture in which he watches, so 靠着墙看球赛. 靠了墙 and 靠过墙 do not fit with a second verb that continues alongside.

q: 老人们坐___下棋，一坐就是一下午。
zh: 老人们坐着下棋，一坐就是一下午。
py: lǎo rén men zuò zhe xià qí yī zuò jiù shì yī xià wǔ
en: The old men sit playing chess, and once they sit down it lasts the whole afternoon.
why: 坐 is the background posture of 下棋, so 坐着下棋. 坐了 or 坐过 followed directly by 下棋 does not describe a posture held while playing.

q: 弟弟光___脚在球场上跑来跑去。
zh: 弟弟光着脚在球场上跑来跑去。
py: dì di guāng zhe jiǎo zài qiú chǎng shàng pǎo lái pǎo qù
en: My younger brother ran around the pitch barefoot.
why: 光着脚 is the held state he is in while running. 光了脚 or 光过脚 would not describe a condition continuing during the running.

q: 孩子抱___篮球睡着了，怎么叫也叫不醒。
zh: 孩子抱着篮球睡着了，怎么叫也叫不醒。
py: hái zi bào zhe lán qiú shuì zháo le zěn me jiào yě jiào bù xǐng
en: The child fell asleep hugging a basketball and could not be woken however hard we called.
why: 抱 is the position held while falling asleep, so 抱着篮球睡着了; the main verb takes 了. 抱过篮球 just says he has hugged one before.

q: 购物车里___几瓶水。
zh: 购物车里放着几瓶水。
py: gòu wù chē lǐ fàng zhe jǐ píng shuǐ
en: There are a few bottles of water in the shopping cart.
why: Place + 放着 + quantity + noun describes what is sitting there. 在放 needs someone who is putting things in right now, and 放在 must be followed by a place, not a quantity.

q: 门上___一张通知，说商店今天休息。
zh: 门上贴着一张通知，说商店今天休息。
py: mén shàng tiē zhe yī zhāng tōng zhī shuō shāng diàn jīn tiān xiū xi
en: A notice is stuck on the door saying the shop is closed today.
why: Place first, then 贴着, then 一张 + noun. 在贴 would need a person sticking it up right now, and 贴在 cannot be followed by 一张通知.

q: 商店门口___很多自行车。
zh: 商店门口停着很多自行车。
py: shāng diàn mén kǒu tíng zhe hěn duō zì xíng chē
en: Lots of bicycles are parked at the shop entrance.
why: The entrance is the place and the bikes are what sits there, so 停着 + noun. 在停 would be bikes in the act of pulling in, and 停在 needs a place after it, not a noun.

q: 看台上___很多球迷，都在大声喊。
zh: 看台上坐着很多球迷，都在大声喊。
py: kàn tái shàng zuò zhe hěn duō qiú mí dōu zài dà shēng hǎn
en: Lots of fans are sitting in the stands, all shouting loudly.
why: Place + 坐着 + many fans describes who is sitting there. 坐在 would need a place after it, and 在坐 would mean fans are in the middle of sitting down.

q: 海报上___“周末大减价”五个字。
zh: 海报上写着“周末大减价”五个字。
py: hǎi bào shàng xiě zhe zhōu mò dà jiǎn jià wǔ gè zì
en: The five characters 'weekend big sale' are written on the poster.
why: Writing that is displayed on a surface is Place + 写着 + text. 在写 would mean someone is writing it now, and 写在 would need a place to follow it.

q: 体育馆的墙上___一块大屏幕，上面正播着比赛。
zh: 体育馆的墙上挂着一块大屏幕，上面正播着比赛。
py: tǐ yù guǎn de qiáng shàng guà zhe yī kuài dà píng mù shàng miàn zhèng bō zhe bǐ sài
en: A big screen hangs on the wall of the stadium, showing a match.
why: Place + 挂着 + 一块 + noun says what is hanging there. 在挂 means someone is hanging it now, and 挂在 would need a place, not 一块大屏幕, after it.

q: 钱包里还___两百块钱，够买这双球鞋了。
zh: 钱包里还放着两百块钱，够买这双球鞋了。
py: qián bāo lǐ hái fàng zhe liǎng bǎi kuài qián gòu mǎi zhè shuāng qiú xié le
en: There are still two hundred yuan in the wallet, enough for these shoes.
why: Place + 放着 + amount describes what is sitting in the wallet. 在放 would be someone putting money in right now, and 放在 cannot take an amount of money after it.

q: 那家运动用品店的橱窗里___好几双新球鞋，价格都不便宜。
zh: 那家运动用品店的橱窗里摆着好几双新球鞋，价格都不便宜。
py: nà jiā yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn de chú chuāng lǐ bǎi zhe hǎo jǐ shuāng xīn qiú xié jià gé dōu bù pián yi
en: Several pairs of new shoes are displayed in the window of that sports shop, and none of them is cheap.
why: The window is the place and the shoes are what is displayed there: 摆着 + noun. 在摆 would mean a person is arranging them now; 摆在 needs a place after it.

q: 你___这个袋子，我去付钱。
zh: 你拿着这个袋子，我去付钱。
py: nǐ ná zhe zhè ge dài zi wǒ qù fù qián
en: Hold this bag while I go and pay.
why: A command to keep holding something while another thing happens is 拿着. 拿了 reports a completed taking and 在拿 describes what he is doing, neither of which is an order to keep holding.

q: 你在这儿___，我去买票。
zh: 你在这儿等着，我去买票。
py: nǐ zài zhè r děng zhe wǒ qù mǎi piào
en: Wait here while I go and buy tickets.
why: 'Stay here and wait' is a command to hold a state: 等着. 等了 and 等过 report something already past, so they cannot make a request for the future.

q: 比赛进行的时候，请大家___，不要站起来。
zh: 比赛进行的时候，请大家坐着，不要站起来。
py: bǐ sài jìn xíng de shí hou qǐng dà jiā zuò zhe bù yào zhàn qǐ lái
en: While the match is on, please stay seated and do not stand up.
why: The point is to remain in the seated state, so 坐着. 坐吧 means 'sit down' and 坐了 reports a completed action, so neither says 'stay seated'.

q: 这张发票你先___，退货的时候要用。
zh: 这张发票你先留着，退货的时候要用。
py: zhè zhāng fā piào nǐ xiān liú zhe tuì huò de shí hou yào yòng
en: Hang on to this receipt for now, as you'll need it when you return the goods.
why: 'Keep it for later' is 留着. 留了 and 留过 describe things that already happened and do not instruct him to keep the receipt.

q: 你们___，下周的比赛很重要。
zh: 你们听着，下周的比赛很重要。
py: nǐ men tīng zhe xià zhōu de bǐ sài hěn zhòng yào
en: Listen up, next week's match is important.
why: An order to pay attention is 听着, a state to enter and keep. 听了 and 听过 describe what has been done, so a coach could not use them to open a speech.

q: 你累了就___休息吧，不用起来帮忙。
zh: 你累了就坐着休息吧，不用起来帮忙。
py: nǐ lèi le jiù zuò zhe xiū xi ba bù yòng qǐ lái bāng máng
en: If you're tired, just stay seated and rest; there's no need to get up and help.
why: 不用起来 shows he is already seated, so the advice is to stay that way: 坐着. 坐了 and 在坐 do not give a suggestion to remain seated.

q: 窗户___开着，是关着的。
zh: 窗户没开着，是关着的。
py: chuāng hu méi kāi zhe shì guān zhe de
en: The window isn't open; it is closed.
why: A 着 state is denied with 没, not 不. 不开着 does not exist as a way of saying a state does not hold.

q: 他今天___戴着眼镜，我差点没认出来。
zh: 他今天没戴着眼镜，我差点没认出来。
py: tā jīn tiān méi dài zhe yǎn jìng wǒ chà diǎn méi rèn chū lái
en: He wasn't wearing glasses today, and I almost didn't recognise him.
why: Denying a state that holds in a particular situation uses 没 + 戴着. 不戴着 is not a pattern; 不 would be for a habit or a refusal and does not combine with 着.

q: 你___坐着了，起来和我们一起打球吧。
zh: 你别坐着了，起来和我们一起打球吧。
py: nǐ bié zuò zhe le qǐ lái hé wǒ men yī qǐ dǎ qiú ba
en: Stop sitting there and come play ball with us.
why: An instruction not to keep a state is 别 + verb + 着. 没坐着了 is not a command and is ungrammatical because 没 reports facts, not orders.

q: 球场上的灯___亮着，我们看不清球。
zh: 球场上的灯没亮着，我们看不清球。
py: qiú chǎng shàng de dēng méi liàng zhe wǒ men kàn bù qīng qiú
en: The lights on the pitch aren't on, so we can't see the ball clearly.
why: The lights were not in the on state, so it is 没 + 亮着. 不亮着 is never used to deny a 着 state.

q: 商店的门今天早上___锁着，我一推就开了。
zh: 商店的门今天早上没锁着，我一推就开了。
py: shāng diàn de mén jīn tiān zǎo shang méi suǒ zhe wǒ yī tuī jiù kāi le
en: The shop door wasn't locked this morning; it opened as soon as I pushed.
why: The state 'locked' did not hold on one particular morning, so 没 + 锁着. 不锁着 is not used to deny a 着 state.

q: 她手里___拿着钱包，原来钱包忘在家里了。
zh: 她手里没拿着钱包，原来钱包忘在家里了。
py: tā shǒu lǐ méi ná zhe qián bāo yuán lái qián bāo wàng zài jiā lǐ le
en: She wasn't holding her wallet; it turns out she had left it at home.
why: The state of holding the wallet did not exist, so 没 + 拿着. 不拿着 cannot negate 拿着.

q: 爷爷___在沙发上看球赛。
zh: 爷爷躺在沙发上看球赛。
py: yé ye tǎng zài shā fā shàng kàn qiú sài
en: Grandpa is lying on the sofa watching the match.
why: With verb + 在 + place, 着 does not appear: 躺在沙发上. 躺着在 is ungrammatical, and 躺了在 puts 了 where the verb takes 在.

q: 爷爷在沙发上___看球赛。
zh: 爷爷在沙发上躺着看球赛。
py: yé ye zài shā fā shàng tǎng zhe kàn qiú sài
en: Grandpa is lying on the sofa watching the match.
why: When the place comes first as 在沙发上, the verb needs 着 to show the lying state, then the next verb: 躺着看球赛. A bare 躺 or 躺了 followed by 看 does not make the posture the background.

q: 小王喜欢___歌做作业。
zh: 小王喜欢唱着歌做作业。
py: xiǎo wáng xǐ huan chàng zhe gē zuò zuò yè
en: Xiao Wang likes to sing while doing his homework.
why: 着 goes inside the verb-object word, between 唱 and 歌: 唱着歌. 唱了 and 唱过 report completed or past singing and do not make it a background activity.

q: 奶奶一直在商店门口坐___，等孙子买完球鞋。
zh: 奶奶一直在商店门口坐着，等孙子买完球鞋。
py: nǎi nai yī zhí zài shāng diàn mén kǒu zuò zhe děng sūn zi mǎi wán qiú xié
en: Grandma has been sitting at the shop door waiting for her grandson to finish buying sneakers.
why: 一直 describes a held posture, and with 在 + place first the verb ends in 着: 在门口坐着. 坐了 would just report that she sat down.

q: 他们边喝___茶边聊最近的球赛。
zh: 他们边喝着茶边聊最近的球赛。
py: tā men biān hē zhe chá biān liáo zuì jìn de qiú sài
en: They chatted about recent matches while drinking tea.
why: 着 attaches to the verb before its object: 喝着茶. 边喝了茶 and 边喝过茶 are not used because 边 … 边 needs two actions happening together.

q: 我不知道___这家店几点关门。
zh: 我不知道这家店几点关门。
py: wǒ bù zhī dào zhè jiā diàn jǐ diǎn guān mén
en: I don't know what time this shop closes.
why: 知道 is a mental state and never takes 着, so nothing goes in the blank.

q: 我们在商店门口等___三个小时，他才来。
zh: 我们在商店门口等了三个小时，他才来。
py: wǒ men zài shāng diàn mén kǒu děng le sān gè xiǎo shí tā cái lái
en: We waited at the shop door for three hours before he came.
why: A duration (三个小时) measures the action, so it takes 了. 着 describes a state and cannot be followed by a length of time.

q: 教练说的话我都听懂___，不用再说了。
zh: 教练说的话我都听懂了，不用再说了。
py: jiào liàn shuō de huà wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le bù yòng zài shuō le
en: I understood everything the coach said, so there's no need to say it again.
why: 听懂 already has a result complement and reports a completed outcome, so 了. 着 cannot be added to a verb with a result complement.

q: 我觉得___这双鞋有点儿贵，你觉得呢？
zh: 我觉得这双鞋有点儿贵，你觉得呢？
py: wǒ jué de zhè shuāng xié yǒu diǎn r guì nǐ jué de ne
en: I think these shoes are a bit expensive. What do you think?
why: 觉得 is an opinion verb and takes no 着, so the blank stays empty.

q: 我哥哥现在在___超市，不在家。
zh: 我哥哥现在在超市，不在家。
py: wǒ gē ge xiàn zài zài chāo shì bù zài jiā
en: My older brother is at the supermarket now, not at home.
why: 在 as 'be at' is a location verb with nothing to hold, so it never takes 着.

q: 他去年大学毕业___，现在在体育用品店工作。
zh: 他去年大学毕业了，现在在体育用品店工作。
py: tā qù nián dà xué bì yè le xiàn zài zài tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn gōng zuò
en: He graduated from university last year and now works in a sports shop.
why: 毕业 is an instant event with no continuing state, so it takes 了 and never 着.

q: 比赛七点开始，我们六点半就到___体育场了。
zh: 比赛七点开始，我们六点半就到了体育场了。
py: bǐ sài qī diǎn kāi shǐ wǒ men liù diǎn bàn jiù dào le tǐ yù chǎng le
en: The match starts at seven, and we had already arrived at the stadium by half past six.
why: 到 is an instant arrival with no state to hold, so 到了. 到着 does not exist.

zh: 柜台上摆着几双新球鞋。
py: guì tái shàng bǎi zhe jǐ shuāng xīn qiú xié
en: Several pairs of new sneakers are displayed on the counter.
why: The place comes first, then the verb with 着, then the quantity and the thing. The thing cannot come before the place.

zh: 老板摇着头说：“不能再便宜了。”
py: lǎo bǎn yáo zhe tóu shuō bù néng zài pián yi le
en: The boss said, shaking his head, "I can't go any cheaper."
why: 摇着头 is the manner and goes before the main verb 说. 说 cannot take 着 here because it is the main action.

zh: 球迷们站着看完了整场比赛。
py: qiú mí men zhàn zhe kàn wán le zhěng chǎng bǐ sài
en: The fans watched the whole match standing up.
why: 站着 is the background posture and comes first; 看完了 is the main verb with its result and 了.

zh: 他穿着一件旧球衣。
py: tā chuān zhe yī jiàn jiù qiú yī
en: He is wearing an old jersey.
why: 着 comes right after the verb, before the object phrase.

zh: 桌上的灯还亮着呢。
py: zhuō shàng de dēng hái liàng zhe ne
en: The lamp on the desk is still on.
why: 还 sits before the verb phrase with 着, and 呢 closes the sentence.

zh: 你先拿着这些票。
py: nǐ xiān ná zhe zhè xiē piào
en: Hold on to these tickets for now.
why: 先 goes before the verb, and 着 follows 拿 to say keep holding.

zh: 你要记着带球鞋。
py: nǐ yào jì zhe dài qiú xié
en: Remember to bring your sneakers.
why: 记着 keeps the thing in mind and comes before the action to remember. 要 goes before 记着.

zh: 他今天没穿着外套。
py: tā jīn tiān méi chuān zhe wài tào
en: He isn't wearing a coat today.
why: 没 goes directly before 穿着. 不 cannot negate a verb with 着.

zh: 别戴着帽子进来。
py: bié dài zhe mào zi jìn lái
en: Don't come in wearing a hat.
why: 别 + V着 + object + next verb: wearing is the background state while entering.

zh: 小王在球场边站着。
py: xiǎo wáng zài qiú chǎng biān zhàn zhe
en: Xiao Wang is standing at the edge of the pitch.
why: With a place before the verb, the pattern is 在 + place + verb + 着. The place cannot follow 站着.

zh: 她唱着歌走出了商店。
py: tā chàng zhe gē zǒu chū le shāng diàn
en: She walked out of the shop singing.
why: 着 goes inside 唱歌, between 唱 and 歌. 唱歌着 is wrong.

zh: 孩子们在球场上踢球。
py: hái zi men zài qiú chǎng shàng tī qiú
en: The kids are playing football on the pitch.
why: An ordinary action in progress takes 在 before the verb, with the place phrase between 在 and the verb.

zh: 超市门口排着一条很长的队。
py: chāo shì mén kǒu pái zhe yī tiáo hěn cháng de duì
en: A very long line has formed at the supermarket entrance.
why: Place first, then 排着, then 一条 and the described noun. 在 cannot come before the verb.

zh: 价格牌上写着“特价”两个字。
py: jià gé pái shàng xiě zhe tè jià liǎng gè zì
en: The two characters 'special offer' are written on the price tag.
why: Place + 写着 + the text. The place has no 在, and 着 comes straight after 写.

zh: 我等了他一个小时。
py: wǒ děng le tā yī gè xiǎo shí
en: I waited for him for an hour.
why: A duration after the object forces 了, not 着. 等着 cannot be followed by a length of time.

src_py: shāng diàn de mén kāi le
task: Say the shop door is still open (a state, not the moment it opened).
zh: 商店的门还开着。
py: shāng diàn de mén hái kāi zhe
en: The shop door is still open.
why: 还 plus 开着 describes a state that continues. 开了 only reported the change.

task: Say he is wearing the jersey, not putting it on.
zh: 他穿着球衣。
py: tā chuān zhe qiú yī
en: He is wearing a jersey.
why: 穿着 describes the state; 在穿 was the action of putting it on.

src: 她笑了，然后把零钱找给了我。
src_py: tā xiào le rán hòu bǎ líng qián zhǎo gěi le wǒ
task: Make the smile the manner of giving the change: one clause with 着.
zh: 她笑着把零钱找给了我。
py: tā xiào zhe bǎ líng qián zhǎo gěi le wǒ
en: She gave me my change with a smile.
why: The smile accompanies the giving, so 笑着 goes first and 找给了 carries the 了.

src: 他一边听音乐，一边跑步。
src_py: tā yī biān tīng yīn yuè yī biān pǎo bù
task: Say it with 着: listening is the background.
zh: 他听着音乐跑步。
py: tā tīng zhe yīn yuè pǎo bù
en: He runs while listening to music.
why: 听着音乐 becomes the background to the main verb 跑步; 着 goes on the first verb only.

src: 有一张球赛海报，挂在墙上。
src_py: yǒu yī zhāng qiú sài hǎi bào guà zài qiáng shàng
task: Start from the place: a poster is hanging on the wall.
zh: 墙上挂着一张球赛海报。
py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng qiú sài hǎi bào
en: There is a match poster hanging on the wall.
why: Place + 挂着 + 一张 + noun; the thing comes after the verb.

task: Change it to tell him to stay seated (he is already sitting).
zh: 你先坐着吧。
py: nǐ xiān zuò zhe ba
en: Just stay seated for now.
why: 坐着 tells someone to keep the seated state; 坐下 tells them to sit down.

src_py: chāo shì de mén kāi zhe
zh: 超市的门没开着。
py: chāo shì de mén méi kāi zhe
en: The supermarket door isn't open.
why: A 着 state is denied with 没, never 不.

src_py: nǐ tǎng zhe kàn qiú sài
task: Turn it into a warning: don't ...
zh: 别躺着看球赛。
py: bié tǎng zhe kàn qiú sài
en: Don't watch the match lying down.
why: 别 replaces the subject and keeps 着 on the posture verb.

src_py: dì di zuò zài shā fā shàng
task: Move the place in front of the verb and keep the state with 着.
zh: 弟弟在沙发上坐着。
py: dì di zài shā fā shàng zuò zhe
en: My younger brother is sitting on the sofa.
why: With the place in front as 在沙发上, the verb ends with 着 instead of 在.

task: Say we queued for twenty minutes (a duration).
zh: 我们排了二十分钟的队。
py: wǒ men pái le èr shí fēn zhōng de duì
en: We queued for twenty minutes.
why: A duration needs 了, not 着.

s: 超市的灯一直亮了，没人关。
s_py: chāo shì de dēng yī zhí liàng le méi rén guān
zh: 超市的灯一直亮着，没人关。
py: chāo shì de dēng yī zhí liàng zhe méi rén guān
en: The supermarket lights have been on all along and nobody turned them off.
why: 一直 describes a continuing state, so 亮着. 了 reports a change of state and cannot be stretched by 一直.

s: 她早上穿着球衣出门，晚上回来还穿着呢。
s_py: tā zǎo shang chuān zhe qiú yī chū mén wǎn shang huí lái hái chuān zhe ne
zh: 她早上穿着球衣出门，晚上回来还穿着呢。
py: tā zǎo shang chuān zhe qiú yī chū mén wǎn shang huí lái hái chuān zhe ne
en: She went out in her jersey in the morning and was still wearing it when she came back at night.
why: Both 穿着 are right: the first is the posture-like manner of leaving, the second a state that still holds, with 还 and 呢.

s: 侧门在开，所以屋里有点儿冷。
s_py: cè mén zài kāi suǒ yǐ wū lǐ yǒu diǎn r lěng
zh: 侧门开着，所以屋里有点儿冷。
py: cè mén kāi zhe suǒ yǐ wū lǐ yǒu diǎn r lěng
en: The side door is open, so it's a bit cold inside.
why: A door that stays open is a state, 开着. 在开 would mean someone or something is opening it right now, which does not explain a cold room.

s: 妈妈在试衣间换衣服，你在外面等一下。
s_py: mā ma zài shì yī jiān huàn yī fu nǐ zài wài miàn děng yī xià
zh: 妈妈在试衣间换衣服，你在外面等一下。
py: mā ma zài shì yī jiān huàn yī fu nǐ zài wài miàn děng yī xià
en: Mom is changing in the fitting room, so wait outside for a moment.
why: Changing clothes is an action in progress, so 在换衣服 is right; 换着衣服 would sound unfinished.

s: 弟弟哭跑出了球场。
s_py: dì di kū pǎo chū le qiú chǎng
zh: 弟弟哭着跑出了球场。
py: dì di kū zhe pǎo chū le qiú chǎng
en: My younger brother ran out of the pitch crying.
why: The manner verb 哭 needs 着 before the main verb 跑出. Without it the two verbs do not link.

s: 球迷们唱着歌，一路走到了体育场门口。
s_py: qiú mí men chàng zhe gē yī lù zǒu dào le tǐ yù chǎng mén kǒu
zh: 球迷们唱着歌，一路走到了体育场门口。
py: qiú mí men chàng zhe gē yī lù zǒu dào le tǐ yù chǎng mén kǒu
en: The fans walked all the way to the stadium entrance singing.
why: 唱着歌 is the background manner and 走到了 the main action with its 了, so the sentence is correct.

s: 货架上在摆三双新球鞋。
s_py: huò jià shàng zài bǎi sān shuāng xīn qiú xié
zh: 货架上摆着三双新球鞋。
py: huò jià shàng bǎi zhe sān shuāng xīn qiú xié
en: Three pairs of new sneakers are displayed on the shelf.
why: Describing what is sitting somewhere uses Place + 摆着 + noun with no 在 before the verb.

s: 球场边的椅子上坐着几个小孩，手里都拿着冰淇淋。
s_py: qiú chǎng biān de yǐ zi shàng zuò zhe jǐ gè xiǎo hái shǒu lǐ dōu ná zhe bīng qí lín
zh: 球场边的椅子上坐着几个小孩，手里都拿着冰淇淋。
py: qiú chǎng biān de yǐ zi shàng zuò zhe jǐ gè xiǎo hái shǒu lǐ dōu ná zhe bīng qí lín
en: A few children are sitting on the chairs at the side of the pitch, each holding an ice cream.
why: Both parts are correct: Place + 坐着 + noun, and 手里拿着 for what is held.

s: 一张海报挂着门上。
s_py: yī zhāng hǎi bào guà zhe mén shàng
zh: 门上挂着一张海报。
py: mén shàng guà zhe yī zhāng hǎi bào
en: A poster hangs on the door.
why: The place goes first, then 挂着, then the thing. 着 cannot be followed directly by a place.

s: 你坐了吧，我来付钱。
s_py: nǐ zuò le ba wǒ lái fù qián
zh: 你坐着吧，我来付钱。
py: nǐ zuò zhe ba wǒ lái fù qián
en: Stay seated, I'll pay.
why: To tell someone to remain sitting, use 坐着. 坐了吧 is not a command pattern.

s: 这张球票你先拿着，进场的时候要给工作人员看。
s_py: zhè zhāng qiú piào nǐ xiān ná zhe jìn chǎng de shí hou yào gěi gōng zuò rén yuán kàn
zh: 这张球票你先拿着，进场的时候要给工作人员看。
py: zhè zhāng qiú piào nǐ xiān ná zhe jìn chǎng de shí hou yào gěi gōng zuò rén yuán kàn
en: Hold on to this ticket for now; you'll have to show it to the staff when you go in.
why: 拿着 in a command means keep holding it, which is correct here.

s: 大家别站着，快坐下看比赛吧。
s_py: dà jiā bié zhàn zhe kuài zuò xià kàn bǐ sài ba
zh: 大家别站着，快坐下看比赛吧。
py: dà jiā bié zhàn zhe kuài zuò xià kàn bǐ sài ba
en: Everyone, don't just stand there; sit down and watch the match.
why: 别 + V着 is the right way to tell people not to stay in a state; 不 would not work here.

s: 他今天不戴着手表，所以不知道现在几点。
s_py: tā jīn tiān bù dài zhe shǒu biǎo suǒ yǐ bù zhī dào xiàn zài jǐ diǎn
zh: 他今天没戴着手表，所以不知道现在几点。
py: tā jīn tiān méi dài zhe shǒu biǎo suǒ yǐ bù zhī dào xiàn zài jǐ diǎn
en: He wasn't wearing a watch today, so he doesn't know what time it is.
why: A 着 state is denied with 没. 不戴着 is not used.

s: 她喝茶着看球赛。
s_py: tā hē chá zhe kàn qiú sài
zh: 她喝着茶看球赛。
py: tā hē zhe chá kàn qiú sài
en: She watches the match while drinking tea.
why: 着 sticks to the verb and comes before the object: 喝着茶.

s: 老人坐着在长椅上看球赛。
s_py: lǎo rén zuò zhe zài cháng yǐ shàng kàn qiú sài
zh: 老人坐在长椅上看球赛。
py: lǎo rén zuò zài cháng yǐ shàng kàn qiú sài
en: The old man sits on the bench watching the match.
why: Verb + 在 + place does not take 着. Say 坐在长椅上, or put the place first.

s: 他在体育馆门口站着，手里拿着两张球票。
s_py: tā zài tǐ yù guǎn mén kǒu zhàn zhe shǒu lǐ ná zhe liǎng zhāng qiú piào
zh: 他在体育馆门口站着，手里拿着两张球票。
py: tā zài tǐ yù guǎn mén kǒu zhàn zhe shǒu lǐ ná zhe liǎng zhāng qiú piào
en: He is standing at the entrance of the stadium holding two tickets.
why: 在 + place + verb + 着 is a correct shape, and 手里拿着 follows the usual pattern.

s: 我认识着这家店的老板。
s_py: wǒ rèn shi zhe zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn
zh: 我认识这家店的老板。
py: wǒ rèn shi zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn
en: I know the owner of this shop.
why: 认识 is a state verb with nothing to hold and never takes 着.

s: 他看见着我，但是没打招呼。
s_py: tā kàn jiàn zhe wǒ dàn shì méi dǎ zhāo hu
zh: 他看见我，但是没打招呼。
py: tā kàn jiàn wǒ dàn shì méi dǎ zhāo hu
en: He saw me but didn't say hello.
why: 看见 already has a result complement, so 着 cannot follow it.

s: 我们等着教练一个半小时了。
s_py: wǒ men děng zhe jiào liàn yī gè bàn xiǎo shí le
zh: 我们等了教练一个半小时了。
py: wǒ men děng le jiào liàn yī gè bàn xiǎo shí le
en: We have been waiting for the coach for an hour and a half.
why: A duration follows the verb, so it takes 了, not 着.

s: 我在体育用品店挑了半天，最后什么也没买。
s_py: wǒ zài tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn tiāo le bàn tiān zuì hòu shén me yě méi mǎi
zh: 我在体育用品店挑了半天，最后什么也没买。
py: wǒ zài tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn tiāo le bàn tiān zuì hòu shén me yě méi mǎi
en: I browsed in the sports shop for ages and in the end bought nothing.
why: 半天 is a duration, so 挑了半天 is right; 挑着半天 is not possible.
